title: ACME — Cool Flames Investigation with Gases (CFI-G)
objectives: Observe stable low-temperature, nonpremixed cool flames of gaseous fuels and characterize chemical regimes that are obscured by buoyancy on Earth.
approach: Establish nonpremixed gaseous flames in the ACME combustion facility with gravity-driven flow suppressed. Vary reactant composition and operating conditions to study weak, low-temperature flame structures.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
